notes: Pack it like a past gig. Open a shop order and press From a past gig… to start from a gig you've packed before: the same trucks (labels, names, load bars, straps and floor labels too) with every case this order has back in its old spot. The same physical case when the order has it, otherwise another of that type. Where the past gig had a case this order doesn't, a yellow dashed outline with its name marks the spot. Put a case there and the outline goes, or use Clear the outlines in the load panel. When the order has fewer of a type, cases come out a whole stack at a time (the top one, then…
